key_insight: A PANS simulation can reproduce the curvature-driven turbulence features of annular Poiseuille flow at Re_Dh = 8900 with accuracy comparable to DNS and other scale-resolving methods.
engineering_relevance: This suggests a lower-cost alternative for predicting heat-transfer-relevant flow behavior in annular geometries used in devices such as heat exchangers.
method: Used the Partially-Averaged Navier-Stokes (PANS) model within a RANS-based scale-resolving framework.
Simulated turbulent annular Poiseuille flow and varied the resolution of modeled turbulence.
Assessed sensitivity to inner-wall transverse curvature via the radius ratio η = Ri/Ro.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports comparison against DNS and other RANS-based scale-resolving approaches, with PANS finding similar curvature effects despite reduced computational cost.
watch_item: Performance is shown for a specific Reynolds number and geometry, so generalization to other curvature ratios or higher-Re flows may require additional validation.
paper_title: Partially-Averaged Navier-Stokes simulation of turbulent annular Poiseulle flow
